summary: Hinson voted Yea on all three Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Acts in 2024, issued a press release accusing Biden of abandoning Israel, and in August 2025 declared Hamas '100% to blame for the suffering in Gaza' while pledging she 'will always stand with Israel.' Her 2024 vote for the IHRA-based Antisemitism Awareness Act and her 2026 defense of a vote against ending the Iran war round out a consistently pro-Israel record.
